toolchain: Visual Studio 18 2026 Insiders / MSVC, CMake Release, ImGui 1.91.8

provenance.current_source: Uncommitted local implementation identified by source hashes.
provenance.baseline_description: Validated #75 UI before packed search index; uncommitted source snapshot
provenance.benchmark_note: Both scale executables compile the current benchmark source; the before_packed variant links captured pre-packed UI headers/libraries. The snapshot benchmark hash documents the UI capture date, not the expanded benchmark used in these runs.

methodology: Sequential fresh processes; no build/test/native renderer process during timing.
Compact fixture retains full production SceneNode (200 B) or BimElementMetadata (592 B), unique IDs and six nonempty searchable fields.
CPU ImGui NewFrame/widgets/Render without platform or Vulkan backend; no geometry or GPU entity-scale claim.
Fixture creation, correctness interactions, index installation and 24 warmups excluded from steady frame timing.
Seven adaptive batched means; median is not an individual-frame percentile.
C++ and ImGui allocation hooks enabled only in a separate warmed allocation pass.
OS peak working set and peak process commit include setup/verification/reload/timing; sampled private commit may miss brief peaks.
Capacity estimates exclude allocator bookkeeping and previously counted inline string character capacity in addition to owning objects; compare OS peaks for process memory saving.
Closed/collapsed views explicitly mark row interaction inapplicable; BIM filtered verifies its final matching entity rather than middle scrolling.
Changed queries and index construction remain O(N); cached unchanged frames do not rescan.

scale_matrix.isolation: One case and entity count per sequential child process
